spec_text_or_path: Corpse-core loop: kill produces corpse nodes; Corpse Explosion consumes nodes for burst. 'Detonate all corpses in the target area, each corpse dealing X damage to all nearby enemies.' (di-corpse-explosion-necro skill_loop anchor_quote). Accrual to standing spatial-consumable-resource-node docket family (§CROSS row 1). Third pure-corpse-core attestation in basin-3 corpus.

Autonomous companion summons in Werebear loop: wolf, grizzly, oak sage provide DPS and healing per skill_loop store. Autonomous combatants = summoner-GAP per §CROSS row 2. Druid summons are part of the attested combat loop description — their absence is a real player-experience gap. Accrual to standing summoner-deferral docket class.

Bone Wall: 'barrier placed at target location, blocks enemy movement; horizontal obstacle mechanic' (di-bone-wall-necro-pvp skill_geometry anchor_quote). Bone Wall is a PLACED OBSTRUCTION — it blocks enemy pathing, does not deal damage on contact (primary function is movement blocking). This maps as placed_lane for placement shape but the BLOCKING-PATHING function has no engine lane. Distinct from placed_lane damage-delivery emitters (turret/sentry). Review-book: is placed-barrier-as-pathing-blocker a distinct docket class from placed-lane emitter?
